title: VELD-QA: A Large-Scale Dataset for Visual Evidence Grounding and Question Answering in Long Documents
abstract: arXiv:2610.20964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing long-document QA benchmarks rarely combine large-scale human-authored questions with detailed visual evidence annotations, limiting diagnosis of evidence localization and interpretation failures. We present VELD-QA, a large-scale benchmark for Visual Evidence grounding and question answering in Long Documents. It contains 15,000 fully human-authored question-answer pairs across 5,859 real-world PDFs totaling 372,445 pages, balancing chart, table, and complex-layout tasks. Human annotations identify supporting pages and evidence elements and describe cited visual content, enabling separate retrieval and interpretation evaluation. We evaluate nine vision-language models under four evidence settings and seven retrieval-augmented and agentic systems. translated_title: VELD-QA：一个用于长文档中视觉证据定位与问答的大规模数据集
translated_abstract: 现有的长文档问答基准很少将大规模的人工编写问题与详细的视觉证据标注相结合，这限制了对证据定位与解释失败问题的诊断。我们提出了VELD-QA，一个面向长文档中视觉证据定位与问答的大规模基准。它包含15,000个完全由人工编写的问答对，覆盖5,859个真实世界的PDF文档，总计372,445页，并均衡涵盖了图表、表格和复杂布局等任务。人工标注识别支持页面和证据元素，并描述所引用的视觉内容，从而能够对检索和解释能力进行分离评估。我们在四种证据设置下评估了九个视觉语言模型，以及七个检索增强和智能体系统。我们的分析识别出了证据定位和解释方面的瓶颈。基于检索的方法在使用真实支持页面的oracle设置面前表现明显落后。
tldr: 提出了VELD-QA，一个包含15,000个人工编写问答对、覆盖5,859个真实PDF文档（共372,445页）并带有详细视觉证据标注的大规模长文档问答基准，能够对证据检索与解释能力进行分离评估。
en_tdlr: VELD-QA is a large-scale benchmark for visual evidence grounding and question answering in long documents, featuring 15,000 fully human-authored QA pairs across 5,859 real-world PDFs (372,445 pages) with detailed visual evidence annotations that enable separate evaluation of retrieval and interpretation.
